service.description: A data load or a snapshot import between the two jobs of org.moqui.impl.DatabaseServices.plan#LoadWrap: the drop job runs first (waited on), then the load when every key was dropped, and then, whatever the drop or the load did, the restore job (ignorePreviousError), so the keys never stay dropped because the load failed. A restore that does not finish is a failed or pending DbjLoadWrap job, which Database › Overview and Jobs name. Run as the DatabaseLoadWrap ServiceJob from Data › Load and Data › Snapshots; the outcome is its results and a notification. loadKind is data (the entity data options below) or snapshot (zipFilename and the import options of import#EntityDataSnapshot). The jobs check DATABASE_ADMIN.

return.message: A load with the foreign keys dropped needs the DATABASE_ADMIN permission
